# The cases of within, the folder's containment of a finding's path.
# One case a line, four fields split by a tab: the claim, the
# folder, the finding's path, and the path it is read as inside the folder, or
# "refused". \\ is a backslash. The folders are written in two systems'
# spellings, so that every system tests both.
#
# A finding inside the folder is read relative to it.
a drive-letter folder holds a finding at its own prefix	C:/scratch/2	C:/scratch/2/src/a.go	src/a.go
a rooted folder holds a finding at its own prefix	/scratch/2	/scratch/2/src/a.go	src/a.go
a relative finding is inside a drive-letter folder	C:/scratch/2	src/a.go	src/a.go
a relative finding is inside a rooted folder	/scratch/2	src/a.go	src/a.go
a leading dot is dropped	C:/scratch/2	./src/a.go	src/a.go
a leading dot after the prefix is dropped	C:/scratch/2	C:/scratch/2/./src/a.go	src/a.go
#
# A finding outside the folder, in any spelling, is refused.
a relative climb is refused	C:/scratch/2	../x.go	refused
a climb after a drive-letter prefix is refused	C:/scratch/2	C:/scratch/2/../x.go	refused
a climb after a rooted prefix is refused	/scratch/2	/scratch/2/../x.go	refused
a climb out from inside is refused	C:/scratch/2	C:/scratch/2/src/../../x.go	refused
an unclean path inside is refused	C:/scratch/2	C:/scratch/2/src//a.go	refused
a rooted path elsewhere is refused by a drive-letter folder	C:/scratch/2	/etc/passwd	refused
a rooted path elsewhere is refused by a rooted folder	/scratch/2	/etc/passwd	refused
another folder on the same drive is refused	C:/scratch/2	C:/other/x.go	refused
the same folder on another drive is refused	C:/scratch/2	D:/scratch/2/x.go	refused
a drive-letter path is refused by a rooted folder	/scratch/2	C:/scratch/2/x.go	refused
a lower-case drive letter is not folded and is refused	C:/scratch/2	c:/scratch/2/x.go	refused
a drive-relative path is refused	C:/scratch/2	C:x.go	refused
a drive letter after the prefix is refused	C:/scratch/2	C:/scratch/2/C:/x.go	refused
a slash UNC path is refused	C:/scratch/2	//server/share/x.go	refused
a backslash UNC path is refused	C:/scratch/2	\\\\server\\share\\x.go	refused
a backslash path in the folder is refused	C:/scratch/2	C:\\scratch\\2\\x.go	refused
a backslash after the prefix is refused	C:/scratch/2	C:/scratch/2/src\\x.go	refused
a prefix with no separator after it is refused	C:/scratch/2	C:/scratch/22/x.go	refused
a rooted prefix with no separator after it is refused	/scratch/2	/scratch/22/x.go	refused
the drive-letter folder itself is refused	C:/scratch/2	C:/scratch/2	refused
the rooted folder itself is refused	/scratch/2	/scratch/2	refused
the folder with a trailing slash is refused	C:/scratch/2	C:/scratch/2/	refused
an empty path is refused	C:/scratch/2		refused
an empty folder holds no rooted path	(empty)	/x.go	refused
